description: Asymmetric INT3 generalization check on Phase 8's additional models (5 intended; 4 completed, Phi-3-medium abandoned due to HF-custom-code compat issues -- see notes).

Pythia-6.9B.label: Pythia-6.9B
Pythia-6.9B.note: v0.2 classified this as 'research only' (+22.1% of baseline). v0.3 asym INT3 moves it to production tier (+0.92% of baseline) -- largest relative improvement of any model in the sample.

Qwen2.5-14B.label: Qwen2.5-14B
Qwen2.5-14B.note: Very low FP16 baseline (1.96) makes the % metric strict. asym INT3 lands at +4.64% of baseline -- inside the production tier for the first time on this model.

Mistral-7B-v0.1.label: Mistral-7B-v0.1
Mistral-7B-v0.1.note: Smallest relative reduction (56.0%) in the sample -- Mistral's KV distribution is already relatively well-behaved under symmetric INT3 (+2.0% of baseline). asym still cuts the ΔPPL in half.

GPT-J-6B.label: GPT-J-6B
GPT-J-6B.note: head_dim=256, not 128. Confirms modeq's asym implementation is head_dim-agnostic at the per-channel level.

Phi-3-medium-4k-instruct.label: Phi-3-medium-4k-instruct
error_chain: 2) After patching 'type' from 'rope_type' (which was 'default'): ValueError: Unknown RoPE scaling type default (Phi-3 code only knows 'su' / 'yarn').
3) After setting rope_scaling=None to use base RoPE: AttributeError: type object 'DynamicCache' has no attribute 'from_legacy_cache'.
Phi-3-medium-4k-instruct.diagnosis: The bundled modeling_phi3.py in microsoft/Phi-3-medium-4k-instruct (commit 48d87cd5e0523b430d77e93becd3655cd6897230) is incompatible with current transformers. Each HF API patch surfaces the next incompatibility. This is unrelated to modeq -- the same bundled code would fail for any quantization project. Revisit in v0.3.3 when either (a) transformers adds a back-compat shim, (b) Microsoft updates the bundled modeling_phi3.py, or (c) we pin transformers to a version that matches this commit.

verdict: 6 of 6 available models: asym INT3 beats sym INT3 by 56.0-95.8% reduction, mean 68.7%. All 6 land in the production tier (<5% of baseline). v0.2's 'research only' model (Pythia-6.9B) moves to production with the v0.3 asymmetric default. v0.3.2 ships with 6-model validated claim; Phi-3-medium revisit pending HF compat.
